machine.description: High-precision automated multi-plunger transfer molding system designed to encapsulate wire-bonded semiconductor sub-assemblies in high-grade thermoset Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) using high-tonnage hydraulic/servo clamping and precision vacuum-assisted cavity injection.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Leadframe strips are loaded into heated top and bottom mold chases. Solid EMC pellets are loaded into multiple plunger pots. The main press closes under 180 tons of clamping force, pulling a deep vacuum (< 10 mbar) inside the mold chases. Motorized or hydraulic transfer rams melt and inject the liquefied epoxy compound through runner channels into the package cavities, encapsulating the fragile die and gold wire loops without wire sweep or void formation.
subsystems: Precision Multi-Plunger Transfer Injection Ram System
Top & Bottom Precision Mold Chase Tooling with Vacuum Seal
Multi-Zone Cartridge Heating & PID Mold Temperature Controllers
Vacuum De-Gassing Cavity Chamber & High-Capacity Vacuum Pump
Automated Degate, Ejector Pin Bar & Leadframe Unloading Handler

components.name: Mold Chase Tooling (Top & Bottom)
components.function: Precision-machined hardened tool steel blocks with mirror-polished, hard-chrome plated cavities forming the IC package package exterior.
components.importantParameters: Mold chase temperature (°C), parting line planarity (µm), vacuum seal integrity, air vent depth (µm).
components.degradationIndicators: Mold temperature gradient (>10°C delta), resin flash leakage, cavity chrome plating abrasion, air vent clogging.

components.name: Multi-Plunger Transfer Injection System
components.function: Drives hardened transfer plungers to compress and melt epoxy pellets, injecting viscous resin into mold runners at controlled velocity.
components.importantParameters: Plunger force load (kN), plunger velocity (mm/s), transfer time (s), plunger tip clearance.
components.degradationIndicators: Plunger force surge (>30 kN), plunger tip wear, resin bleed past plunger seal, velocity stutter.

components.name: Hydraulic Press Clamping Unit
components.function: Exerts up to 200 tons of clamping force across the mold chase parting line to contain high internal injection pressures.
components.importantParameters: Hydraulic system pressure (bar), clamping tonnage (tons), hydraulic oil temperature (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Hydraulic pressure creep (>175 bar), oil overheating (>62°C), tie-bar elongation imbalance, cylinder seal leakage.

components.name: Vacuum Assist De-Gassing System
components.function: Evacuates air and volatile organic gases from closed mold cavities prior to resin injection to prevent void formation.
components.importantParameters: Cavity vacuum pressure (mbar), evacuation time (s), vacuum valve response latency.
components.degradationIndicators: Cavity vacuum loss (>25 mbar), vacuum filter clogging with epoxy dust, O-ring seal hardening.

components.name: Ejector Pin & Degating Mechanism
components.function: Pushes encapsulated leadframe out of mold cavities and shears hardened runner gates after cure cycle completes.
components.importantParameters: Ejector stroke length (mm), ejector motor force (N), degate shear blade sharpness.
components.degradationIndicators: Ejector pin seizure, package surface indentation, leadframe deformation, incomplete degating.

sensors.purpose: Measures hydraulic system pressure driving the transfer ram during compound injection.

sensors.name: Plunger Force Load
sensors.purpose: Monitors dynamic compression force exerted by the motorized/hydraulic multi-plunger system.

sensors.name: Mold Cavity Vacuum Pressure
sensors.purpose: Measures absolute vacuum level achieved inside the mold cavity chamber before resin injection.

sensors.name: Main Press Clamping Force

sensors.name: Hydraulic Oil Temp

normal.description: Optimal thermoset epoxy polymerization and curing temperature window.

warning.description: Thermal overshoot risking premature resin gelation and incomplete fill.

critical.description: Severe thermal runaway causing resin scorch, gas burns, and mold thermal damage.

normal.description: Nominal hydraulic line pressure delivering smooth transfer stroke.

warning.description: Proportional valve restriction or resin flow resistance elevation.

critical.description: Hydraulic over-pressurization risking hose rupture and excessive mold stress.

normal.description: Balanced multi-plunger compaction and resin flow through runners.

warning.description: Pellet pre-cure resistance or plunger tip friction in pot sleeve.

critical.description: Plunger mechanical binding, gate freeze-off, or severe wire sweep risk.

normal.description: Deep vacuum ensuring complete elimination of micro-voids in package corners.

warning.description: Vacuum seal degradation or particulate debris on mold parting line.

critical.description: Inadequate vacuum causing severe internal package voids and wire sweep defects.

normal.description: Nominal clamping force sealing parting line without tool deformation.

warning.description: Clamping compensation required due to parting line flash buildup.

critical.description: Excessive tonnage causing mold chase plastic deformation or tie-bar fatigue.

normal.description: Optimal oil viscosity and lubrication for proportional valves and pumps.

warning.description: Oil cooler degradation or continuous high-cycle hydraulic loading.

critical.description: Severe oil thermal oxidation, viscosity breakdown, and seal deterioration.

operatingConditions.normalOperatingSpeed: 45 - 90 seconds per complete mold cycle (injection + cure)
operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Melamine cleaning cycle every 200 shots; wax conditioning cycle every 500 shots.
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 168 hours before scheduled mold chase tear-down and ultrasonic cleaning

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Run melamine cleaning compound shots, clean air vents with brass scraper, apply carnauba release wax.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Execute 3 shots of melamine cleaning block. Wipe mold chase with cleanroom cloth, measure air vent depth (target 15 µm).

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Inspect plunger tip OD and pot ID for score marks and resin flash; replace worn plunger tips.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Verify radial clearance between plunger tip and pot sleeve is 0.035 - 0.050 mm using feeler gauge.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Replace 5 µm hydraulic return filter, test oil viscosity/particle count (ISO 4406), clean oil cooler radiator.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Draw oil sample from reservoir. Verify moisture content < 150 ppm and particle cleanliness level 16/14/11.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Replace silicone vacuum perimeter gasket, clean vacuum trap exhaust filter of condensed resin volatiles.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Inspect gasket for hardening or cracks. Verify vacuum decay rate is < 2.0 mbar/sec.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Measure tie-bar ultrasonic elongation to verify balanced tonnage distribution across all 4 columns.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Use ultrasonic bolt tension meter on all 4 tie-bars; verify strain variance across columns is < 3%.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Hydraulic pressure stable between 120 and 150 bar during transfer.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Pressure climbs into 150 - 175 bar as internal valve friction rises or resin viscosity thickens.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Pressure exceeds 175 bar; proportional valve saturation and risk of hydraulic shock.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates proportional directional valve spool wear, internal pump slippage, or fluid contamination.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Plunger compression force maintains steady 18 - 25 kN profile.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Force increases to 25 - 30 kN due to plunger tip carbon buildup or resin pre-gelation.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Force exceeds 30 kN; high risk of wire sweep, die pad fracture, and plunger jamming.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates physical friction between plunger tips and pot sleeves or premature EMC curing in runners.

degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Temperature climbs to 180 - 190 °C or zone temperature delta exceeds 6°C.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Temperature exceeds 190 °C; high risk of epoxy blister defect and scorch burning.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates cartridge heater resistance oxidation, loose thermocouple contact, or SSR phase breakdown.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Pulls deep negative vacuum down to 1.0 - 10.0 mbar prior to injection.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Vacuum only reaches 10.0 - 25.0 mbar as perimeter O-ring seals age.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Vacuum level worse than 25.0 mbar; entrapped air creates catastrophic void defects.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates vacuum seal hardening, parting line resin flash buildup, or vacuum pump vane degradation.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Bulk oil temperature stabilized between 40 and 52 °C.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Oil temperature exceeds 62 °C; thermal oxidation rapidly accelerates.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates heat exchanger fouling, continuous high-pressure relief valve bypass, or low fluid level.

symptoms.symptom: Plunger Injection Force Surge / Wire Sweep Risk
possibleCauses: Epoxy molding compound pellets pre-curing in preheat hopper
Transfer runner gate freeze-off due to low mold temperature in runner zone
Plunger tip carbon residue buildup and mechanical binding
symptoms.recommendedAction: Halt injection stroke, purge mold cavities, clean plunger tips and pot sleeves, verify pellet preheat time (< 45 sec).

symptoms.symptom: Mold Cavity Vacuum Loss / Incomplete Void Elimination
possibleCauses: Silicone vacuum perimeter seal gasket burnt, cracked, or hardened
Parting line resin flash preventing complete seal compression
Vacuum exhaust solenoid valve filter clogged with condensed epoxy vapor
symptoms.recommendedAction: Replace vacuum perimeter seal gasket, clean parting line sealing surfaces, clean vacuum line filter trap.

symptoms.symptom: Hydraulic System Pressure Elevation & Oil Overheating
possibleCauses: Hydraulic proportional directional valve spool varnish contamination
Heat exchanger water flow restricted by scale deposits
Main pump relief valve setting drifting high
symptoms.recommendedAction: Flush proportional valve assembly, descale heat exchanger with chemical flush, verify oil temperature stays < 50°C.

symptoms.symptom: Mold Chase Temperature Asymmetry / Package Warpage
possibleCauses: Cartridge heater element in zone 3 open-circuit or high resistance
Thermocouple probe loose in heater pocket
SSR controller channel intermittent conduction
symptoms.recommendedAction: Measure heater cartridge resistances (nominal 45 Ω each), replace damaged cartridge, verify zone uniformity ± 2°C.

symptoms.symptom: Parting Line Resin Flash / Excess Bleed Defect
possibleCauses: Main clamping cylinder hydraulic pressure droop under injection load
Tie-bar elongation imbalance causing parting line tilting
Mold chase insert wear or mechanical debris caught on parting surface
symptoms.recommendedAction: Verify 180-ton clamping force calibration, inspect parting line with feeler gauge (< 5 µm), clean mold faces.

failureScenarios.symptom: Transfer Plunger Tip Friction Binding & Force Surge
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: load_plunger surges from 22.0 to 32.5 kN; pressure_hydraulic elevated to 168 bar
possibleCauses: Burnt epoxy resin carbonizing in pot sleeve clearance
Plunger tip thermal expansion exceeding pot bore tolerance
Plunger rod misalignment relative to mold base
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Manually retract plungers. Clean pot sleeves with brass brush and release wax. Replace worn plunger tips.
verificationSteps: Run empty plunger stroke test
Verify plunger force < 5 kN at zero load
Run test shot with dummy leadframe

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: vacuum_chamber_pressure degrades from 4.2 mbar to 28.5 mbar; micro-void alert
possibleCauses: Perimeter fluoroelastomer vacuum seal O-ring baked and embrittled
Vacuum line check valve sticking open
Resin flash trapped beneath vacuum seal land
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace mold perimeter vacuum seal. Clean vacuum sealing groove. Verify vacuum achieves < 8 mbar within 3.0 sec.
verificationSteps: Run vacuum decay rate test (< 1.5 mbar/sec)
Inspect X-ray package samples for voiding

failureScenarios.symptom: Hydraulic Proportional Valve Sticking & Pressure Spike
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: pressure_hydraulic rises to 182 bar; transfer velocity stutters during injection
possibleCauses: Hydraulic oil varnish deposits on proportional valve spool lands
Hydraulic oil particle contamination exceeding ISO 18/16/13
Valve LVDT position feedback sensor drift
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace proportional flow control valve. Replace 5 µm high-pressure system filter. Flush hydraulic lines.
verificationSteps: Execute hydraulic step-response calibration
Verify smooth transfer velocity profile

failureScenarios.symptom: Mold Chase Cartridge Heater Open Circuit
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: temperature_mold zone 3 drops to 154°C while other zones at 175°C
possibleCauses: Internal nickel-chromium wire burnout in cartridge heater
Terminal connection terminal block screw loosened by thermal cycling
Solid-state relay gate drive failure
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace burnt cartridge heater in zone 3. Apply thermal conductive grease. Verify zone reaches 175°C.
verificationSteps: Thermal camera scan of mold chase
Verify temperature uniformity across all cavities ± 2°C

failureScenarios.symptom: Hydraulic Reservoir Heat Exchanger Scale Fouling
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: hydraulic_oil_temperature climbs to 64.2°C under continuous 24/7 production
possibleCauses: Facility cooling water mineral scale clogging tube-and-shell heat exchanger
Thermostatic water regulation valve failed in closed position
Oil circulation pump flow rate reduction
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Descale heat exchanger with circulating acid cleaner. Clean cooling water strainer. Verify oil cools to 45°C.
verificationSteps: Monitor oil temperature over 5 mold cycles
Verify stability at 46 ± 2°C

failureScenarios.symptom: Tie-Bar Strain Imbalance Causing Parting Line Flash
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: clamping_tonnage reads 195 tons; resin flash detected on right cavity bay
possibleCauses: Uneven thermal expansion of tie-bar columns
Clamping nut lock washer backing off on column 4
Mold chase mounting base parallel alignment error
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Measure tie-bar strain with ultrasonic gauge. Re-torque column nuts to equalize 45 tons per column.
verificationSteps: Check parting line contact with pressure-sensitive film (Fuji Prescale)
Verify even color density across all 4 corners

failureScenarios.symptom: Degating Shear Blade Dullness and Package Chipping
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Ejector motor current climbs by 25%; package leadframe trim burr alert
possibleCauses: Tungsten carbide degating cutter blade edge chipped from repeated shearing
Degate hydraulic cylinder pressure drop
Leadframe carrier rail guide play
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace degating shear blade set. Adjust shear clearance to 0.02 mm.
verificationSteps: Inspect 20 degated leadframes under scope
Verify clean runner separation without gate residue

failureScenarios.symptom: Ejector Pin Galling and Mechanical Seizure
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Ejector cylinder travel timeout alarm; hydraulic pressure brief surge
possibleCauses: Resin flash migrating into ejector pin guide bushings
Ejector pin lubrication breakdown at 175°C operating temperature
Ejector plate guide pillar binding
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Disassemble ejector plate, clean pin bushings with brass reamer, apply high-temp Krytox grease.
verificationSteps: Perform 10 full ejector stroke cycles in dry run
Verify smooth actuation without sticking

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Cycle pause alert; pellet feed tray empty sensor triggers false alarm
possibleCauses: Pellet hopper suction cup vacuum line cracked
Pellet dust blocking optical level sensor lens
Pellet carousel stepper motor drive belt slipped
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean optical pellet sensor windows with IPA wipe. Inspect feeder vacuum tubing.
verificationSteps: Run automatic pellet loading sequence for 10 pots
Verify correct pellet delivery

failureScenarios.symptom: Mold Cavity Air Vent Clogging & Gas Burning
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Resin scorch burn marks on end cavities; vacuum pressure reading stable
possibleCauses: Condensed epoxy wax and silica filler accumulating in 15 µm air vent grooves
Melamine cleaning interval exceeded 300 shots
Excessive injection speed compressing entrapped volatiles
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Perform 4 melamine cleaning shots. Clean air vent channels manually with soft brass scraper.
verificationSteps: Inspect molded package corners under microscope
Confirm zero dark scorch marks

failureScenarios.symptom: Clamping Cylinder Piston Hydraulic Seal Bypass
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: clamping_tonnage decays by 15 tons during high-pressure transfer hold phase
possibleCauses: High-pressure hydraulic piston polyurethane U-cup seal extrusion
Cylinder inner bore micro-scoring
Clamping pilot-operated check valve seat leakage
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace clamping cylinder piston seal set. Inspect pilot check valve.
verificationSteps: Perform 15-minute clamping pressure hold test at 180 tons
Verify pressure drop < 2 bar

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: All mold zone temperatures read 15°C offset from actual surface pyrometer
possibleCauses: Temperature controller terminal block isothermal cold-junction RTD open
Thermocouple extension wire polarity reversed
Electrical enclosure internal cooling fan failed
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace temperature input module cold-junction reference sensor. Verify with calibrated thermocouple calibrator.
verificationSteps: Compare controller display with NIST-traceable surface probe (must match within ± 1.0°C)

failureScenarios.symptom: Mold Chase Bottom Plate Vacuum Gasket Creep
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: vacuum_chamber_pressure fluctuates erratically between 6 and 22 mbar
possibleCauses: Gasket retaining groove corner expansion
Residual epoxy pellet fragments pinching gasket perimeter
Vacuum line manifold quick-disconnect coupling loose
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Inspect gasket retention groove, clean debris, replace silicone profile seal.
verificationSteps: Verify vacuum seal seating with vacuum test cycle (< 8 mbar)
